Copilot Projects changes the AI video handoff, not your creative judgment.

WHAT CHANGED
GitHub put Projects in public preview on October 28. The Copilot app can keep a project's context, agents and results together.

WHAT IT DOES
Give a project a goal and relevant material. Agents can work with that context and bring back results for review. It is not a guarantee of a finished film.

WHY BUILDERS SHOULD CARE
On Tech Thursday, the host searched for the exact prompt before walking through a plan for six reference frames and five clips. That moment made the cost of a scattered brief visible. Projects is a new way to test a more organized handoff, not something we used in that recording.

TRY THIS THIS WEEK
1. Open a project in the updated Copilot app. Add your character references, environment references and scene order.
2. Ask: "Draft a six-frame storyboard and five transition prompts. Keep the character, wardrobe and lighting consistent. Return the plan for review before any clip generation."
3. Check all six frames against the references. Test the hardest transition in your video tool before rendering the full sequence.

THE SIGNAL
AI tools are moving beyond isolated chats toward work with context and reviewable outputs. Your brief and acceptance checks still matter.

Save this for your next AI video build.
